    A

    assemble(AssembleRequest) - Method in class network.ike.knowledge.provider.ChronologyStoreAssembler
     

    C

    ChronologyStoreAssembler - Class in network.ike.knowledge.provider
    Assembles a knowledge base in a Spined Array store — the chronology-store KnowledgeBaseAssembler: an optional store-seed layer, ordered entity loads inside the bulk-load bracket, the stated navigation derived from the loaded stated definitions (StatedNavigationDeriver), and, by default, a full classification whose inferred axiom and navigation semantics make the assembled KB navigable the moment a browser opens it.
    ChronologyStoreAssembler() - Constructor for class network.ike.knowledge.provider.ChronologyStoreAssembler
    Creates the provider (ServiceLoader requirement).
    ChronologyStoreExporter - Class in network.ike.knowledge.provider
    Exports a knowledge set's change-set artifact from its ledger source — the chronology-store KnowledgeExporter: discovers the KnowledgeSetSource, replays the composed session into a fresh in-memory store, exports the store by real time (which excludes the store's startup sentinel stamp), and optionally extracts the koncept definitions from the same materialized store — one materialization, both artifacts.
    ChronologyStoreExporter() - Constructor for class network.ike.knowledge.provider.ChronologyStoreExporter
    Creates the provider (ServiceLoader requirement).
    ChronologyStoreVerifier - Class in network.ike.knowledge.provider
    The chronology-store KnowledgeVerifier: assembles a pristine throwaway store from the declared base plus the artifact under verification and runs the requested checks against it — never against the store that produced the artifact (IKE-Network/ike-issues#852, #951).
    ChronologyStoreVerifier() - Constructor for class network.ike.knowledge.provider.ChronologyStoreVerifier
    Creates the provider (ServiceLoader requirement).
